data.body_html:
Welcome 2046 in style with a marbella boat rental new years eve 2045 fireworks cruise from Puerto Banús. Skip the crowded beachfront and hotel rooftops — from the sea, you get an uninterrupted view of the entire fireworks display, with the glittering Costa del Sol coastline as your backdrop. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT, so there are no hidden costs.

Why Celebrate NYE on a Boat in Marbella?

Marbella's New Year's Eve fireworks are launched from the promenade near Puerto Banús, and the best seats in the house are on the water. From a private yacht, you see the full arc of the show reflected on the sea. No jostling for space, no queues for the bar — just you, your guests, and the midnight sky.

The average December sea temperature in Marbella is 16°C, so bring a jacket for the deck. Our boats have heated cabins for comfort between the main event.

Our NYE Fleet: Which Boat is Right for You?

We operate from Puerto Banús with boats ranging from 6.4m to 29m. Here are the top picks for fireworks viewing:

  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) — Spacious flybridge with 360° views. Ideal for a party of 12.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — Open-plan deck, jet ski included free on 4-hour bookings (€4,719 min).
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) — Best value at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours.
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) — Sporty and fast, with a large aft deck for socialising.

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are cosy options. View the full fleet on our [boat rental Marbella](/ ) page.

Pricing for NYE 2045

Boat TierExamplesPrice (2h)Price (8h)

Other boatsFerretti 94, Canados 86, etc.Pricing on request via WhatsApp

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No surprises.

What's Included in Your NYE Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You can bring your own food, decorations, and music. Just coordinate with the skipper beforehand.

Best Fireworks Viewing Spots from the Sea

Our skippers will anchor in the bay between Puerto Banús and Marbella's Golden Mile, roughly 200–400 metres offshore. This position gives you a direct line of sight to the main launch site near the Río Verde estuary. You'll also see secondary displays from Estepona and Sotogrande in the distance.

If you book a longer charter (4+ hours), we can cruise along the coast to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés before returning for the midnight show.

How to Book Your NYE 2045 Boat

Demand for New Year's Eve is extremely high. We recommend reserving by November 2045 to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Contact us via WhatsApp with your group size and preferred duration, and we'll confirm availability within 2 hours.

For more ideas, read our guide on [boat rental Marbella New Year's Eve](/blog/marbella-boat-rental-nye-2045-fireworks-view/).

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best boat for watching NYE fireworks in Marbella?

For a group of up to 12 guests, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) or Mangusta 80 (24m) offer excellent viewing decks. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) is a great value choice. All depart from Puerto Banús.

How much does a boat rental for NYE 2045 cost?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) cost €4,719 minimum for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What is included in the NYE charter?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your group and enjoy the fireworks.

Can we watch the Marbella fireworks from the boat?

Yes, we anchor in prime positions near the Marbella coastline, offering unobstructed views of the NYE fireworks display. The skipper will choose the best spot based on wind and safety conditions.

How many people can we bring on the boat?

Capacity varies: boats like the Dubhe (8m) take up to 5 passengers, the Astondoa 40 takes 9, and the Azimut 58 or Mangusta 80 can hold up to 12. Check the fleet page for exact numbers.

Do we need to book far in advance for NYE 2045?

Absolutely. New Year's Eve is the busiest night of the year. We recommend booking by November 2045 to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability.

Can we bring our own food or decorations?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and decorations. The boat provides a cooler and table space. Just let the skipper know in advance so we can prepare.

What if the weather is bad on NYE?

Your safety is our priority. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, we will reschedule or offer a full refund. Typically, Marbella's winter weather is mild, but we monitor forecasts closely.
